toolbar.toggleList: Show or hide the guest list
toolbar.fit: Fit the whole plan on screen

canvas.hint: Start by adding tables from the toolbar (Table ▾). Then add or paste your guests in the list on the left and drag them onto seats.
canvas.emptyReadOnly: This plan has no tables yet.

sidebar.title: Guest list
sidebar.noGuests: No guests yet. Type a name above or paste a whole list.

groups.hint: Drag a group onto a table to fill its free seats in one go.
groups.hintReadOnly: Groups and how many of each are seated.
groups.none: No groups yet. Groups are created when you add a guest with a group, or import a list with a group column.
groups.name: Group name
groups.confirmDelete: Delete the group "{{name}}"? Its guests stay in the list.

import.title: Paste or import guests
import.help: One name per line. Or columns separated by comma, semicolon or tab: name, group, child, note. A header row (name, group, child, note) is recognised.
import.example:
Maria Papadopoulou, Papadopoulos family
Nikos Papadopoulos, Papadopoulos family, yes, high chair
John Smith

seating.groupPartial: Seated {{placed}} from {{group}}; {{left}} did not fit and stayed where they were.

conflict.notice: {{winner}} and {{loser}} were placed on the same seat ({{table}}, seat {{seat}}) at the same time. {{winner}} keeps it; {{loser}} is back in Unseated.

presence.nameHelp: Others editing this plan will see this name next to your cursor.

share.title: Share this plan
share.intro: Sharing creates two links: one lets people edit with you in real time, the other only lets them view.
share.privacy1: Until now your plan lived only in this browser.
share.privacy2: Sharing stores a copy, including guest names, on the SeatPlan sync server.
share.privacy3: Anyone with a link can open the plan. Send links only to people you trust.
share.privacy4: The copy is deleted when you click "Stop sharing", or automatically 30 days after the last edit. No accounts, no analytics.
share.rateLimited: Too many shared plans were created from this network. Try again in an hour.
share.unreachable: The sync server could not be reached. Your plan is safe in this browser; try again later.
share.editLink: Edit link: can change the plan
share.viewLink: View-only link: for the venue or family
share.linkHint: Anyone with the edit link can change the plan. Changes appear for everyone within a second.
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
share.expiry: The shared copy is deleted automatically 30 days after the last edit.
share.confirmStop: Stop sharing? The plan will be deleted from the server and both links stop working. Your copy in this browser stays.
share.stopped: Sharing stopped. The plan is now only in this browser.
share.viewerInfo: You are viewing this plan. Only people with the edit link can change it.

status.offline: Offline: your changes are kept and will sync when the connection is back

export.title: Print & export
export.printHint: To get a PDF of a list, choose "Save as PDF" in the print dialog.
export.confirmImport: Replace the current plan with the imported file? You can undo this.
export.badFile: That file is not a SeatPlan plan.
export.newerVersion: That plan was saved by a newer version of SeatPlan. Please reload the page and try again.

settings.title: Plan settings
settings.name: Event name
settings.unitsHint: Sizes are approximate canvas units (a round table for 8 is 120 wide).
settings.newHint: Clears tables, objects and guests. You can undo it, but export the plan first if you want to keep it.
settings.confirmNew: Start a new, empty plan? This clears everything (you can undo).

banner.unauthorized: This link is not valid (any more). Ask for a new link.
banner.roomGone: This shared plan was deleted by its owner or expired. Your copy in this browser is still here, read-only.
banner.confirmKeep: Replace the plan stored in this browser with this copy?
banner.sharingEnded: Sharing of this plan has ended (stopped or expired). Your plan is still here.
banner.roomFull: Too many people are in this plan right now. Retrying…
banner.viewOnly: View only: you can look, zoom, print and export, but not change the plan.
banner.phone: On phones SeatPlan is view-only. Use a tablet or computer to edit.
banner.offline: Not connected. Your changes are kept here and will sync when the connection is back.
banner.noSharing: This site has no sync server, so shared links do not work here. Your own plan is shown instead.
